title: Ordinary nerve and internal functor simplicial sets, with parameterized evaluation
statement:
Use small ordinary nerves, standard simplices, simplicial products and internal functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in a fixed containing universe. Let $J,I$ be small ordinary categories. The ordinary category $\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{Cat}}(J,I)$ has functors as objects and natural transformations as arrows, composed componentwise. Its evaluation functor sends $(F,j)$ to $F(j)$. The map induced by the nerve of evaluation is a natural isomorphism of simplicial sets
$$\rho_{J,I}:N(\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{Cat}}(J,I))\xrightarrow{\cong}\operatorname{Fun}(N(J),N(I)).$$
Explicitly, a string $F_0\Rightarrow\cdots\Rightarrow F_r$ corresponds under $\rho_{J,I}$ to the map $N(J)\times\Delta^r\to N(I)$ obtained by taking the nerve of its evaluation functor $J\times[r]\to I$; evaluation on $(j,t)$ is $F_t(j)$, and mixed arrows use the given natural transformations. For every small simplicial set $X$ and simplicial map $f:N(I)\to X$, postcomposition gives a simplicial map
$$N(\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{Cat}}(J,I))\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(N(J),X).$$
The image of the displayed string is the entire prism $N(J)\times\Delta^r\to N(I)\xrightarrow{f}X$, including its faces and degeneracies. These formulas commute with restriction along every ordinary functor $q:J'\to J$ and every monotone map $\alpha:[s]\to[r]$, simultaneously: restriction of the prism is the prism of the restricted string on $J'\times[s]$. In particular, for $q:[k]\to J$ the resulting $(k,r)$-parameter prism retains all parameter faces and degeneracies, including composition faces and identity degeneracies. No invertibility of the natural transformations and no quasicategory hypothesis on $X$ is required.
